Nothing here is merged with either of the others, and this record does not treat any of them as a correction of another's rows. The index cache note attached to this key still carries stale wording calling it 'the SECOND June-16-Primary report'; the DOCUMENT's own checked box says otherwise and the document governs - flagging it, not editing it.
